option.DisplayText: Enable showing the relic revealer after world gen
option.helptext:
When enabled, after world generation has been completed and immediately before control is handed to you, the relic revealer will be displayed.
The default is {{w|Enabled}}.

option.DisplayText: Enable showing the relic revealer again when a save is loaded
option.helptext:
When enabled, after a save game is loaded and immediately before control is handed to you, the relic revealer will be displayed.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: Enable a set of two activated abilities for revealing relics and revealing cherubim
option.helptext:
When enabled, you gain two activated abilities, one each for revealing relics (showing the Relic Tracker), and revealing cherubim (showing the Cherubim Viewer).
Toggling this option should add and remove the relevant activated abilities.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.
